mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic and CNS stimulant properties that may potentiate anticholinergic effects and increase CNS stimulation, with modafinil also potentially inhibiting benztropine metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor for excessive anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, tachycardia, confusion) and CNS overstimulation; consider dose adjustment or alternative agent if symptoms develop.
